scientific_integrity: Exact deterministic computations supplement an explicit finite-group and elementary valuation proof. No independent validation claimed; residual prior-literature risk stated.
scientific_limitations: Explicit dyadic-stratum classification only for 1 <= a <= 4; the general gcd identity applies at higher levels.
The odd part of q-1 must be a single odd prime to the first power.
No claim of infinitely many cofactor primes or of exact classifications for three consecutive NSNP elements.
The earlier resultant values in OEIS A255831 and the count N(49)=2 from Cohen 2026 are acknowledged as previously known.
Full text of the 2026 Zhou-Wu tuple paper not accessible; its abstract was inspected.
title: Characteristic-local adjacency among sparse-order finite-field nonsquares
